correctness.rationale: A graph matching-polynomial identity valid over all characteristic-two fields gives χ(H_n)=X²f_(n−2). The proved path doubling identities determine exact zero multiplicity. A separate vertex-by-vertex kernel computation gives nullity two for even n and one for odd n. This forces zero-primary Jordan partition (1,1) or a single block of length 2^{ν₂(n−1)}+1. The Fitting decomposition provides exact labelled first-periodic-entry shell counts, and nilpotence of exact index n at n=2^a+1. Standalone verification tests 1,071 ranks, 18 matching polynomials and 32,752 full binary trajectories, without claiming to prove infinite cases computationally.
